## Scope
Task IDs and phase; current integration branch; shared contracts touched.

## Behavior and compatibility
What changes for users, permissions, state migrations, API/marks, and installation?

## Evidence
Exact source/toolchain; actual commands; expected and executed tests; negative controls; outcomes.
Distinguish static, mocked, native, browser, live-network and independent review evidence.

## Safety and recovery
Sensitive data/credentials absent; resource bounds; upgrade/rollback; known limitations.

## Coordination
Preserve current implementation work. No original-repo writes, purchases, live identities,
public visibility change, or production deployment without explicit authorization.
Planning changes do not close implementation issues or imply release acceptance.
